title: The First Reflection
summary: A brief optional quest that helps the player add one confirmed observation to the Living Chronicle.
playerValue: Create one useful, player-confirmed starting point in the Living Chronicle without requiring broad disclosure.
objective: Confirm one brief personal observation chosen by the player.

requirements.description: The player confirms one observation they chose to record.

accessibilityVariants.label: Text-only reflection
accessibilityVariants.description: Complete the reflection without voice, animation, or timed interaction.

feedback: Show the confirmed observation, its source, and what changed in the Chronicle.
narrativeConsequence: The first page of the Living Chronicle becomes visible at Lantern Shore.
deferralPath: The player may continue exploring Lantern Shore and return later without penalty.
refusalPath: The player may decline and continue without creating a Chronicle entry.
analyticsHypothesis: A short, clearly optional first reflection can demonstrate immediate Chronicle value without increasing pressure to disclose.
